status: development diagnostic chosen after inspecting the existing KA-1 failures; frozen before this new run

intervention.name: integer-terminal-period-v1
intervention.rule: Only on an amount case and valid UTF-8, fullmatch the trimmed response against ASCII digits followed by one period; return those exact digits. Otherwise preserve the response byte-for-byte as decoded. No prompt, generated ID, parameter, answer digit, policy or acceptance criterion is changed.

comparison.pairing: One actual generation per original candidate/case/locale/policy/seed; both display conditions use that same output. Time generation and immediately following normalization separately; normalized total is their measured sum. No best-of seed selection.
comparison.cases: All original six bilingual cases, both checkpoints, both policies and all three repeats, including failures.
comparison.semantics: Require exact reproduction of each existing output before reusing its disclosed author semantic judgment. Repair only a terminal sentence period in an integer-amount response; preserve semantic score and state why. An unseen output must stop for new adjudication.
comparison.gate: Original six robust semantic cases in each language and original hard failures, unchanged; strict-format gains cannot override them.
comparison.repetitions: Greedy repeats are timing/stability repeats, not independent questions; stress policy remains separate.

retention: Retain raw KA-1 contracts/runs/adjudication and all nine KA-0 queries with Keyword, BoW Count and TF-IDF results. No facts are added, no order is operated.
expected_from_prior_evidence: English selected-50 literal format can improve while historical 750 remains wrong; bilingual semantic gate is expected to remain failed. This expectation is disclosed, not a blind test prediction.
